# libsodium / crypto_box_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `crypto_box_fuzzer` ([source](source/crypto_box_fuzzer.cc), unmodified) over libsodium (jedisct1/libsodium at 2c61b499).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: crypto_box_open_easy(crypto_box_easy(m)) must succeed and reproduce m exactly (message from input, nonce from input, keypair 1 from an input seed, keypair 2 from the input-seeded deterministic RNG).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libsodium at commit 2c61b499.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- crypto_box_easy must return 0 on every input ([line 53](source/crypto_box_fuzzer.cc#L53)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libsodium` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `crypto_box_fuzzer.plain` | 128,200 | `caeee395343e60ea34ea968b86368f670bd74f1fceddbe4b67652ecd451bdcbb` |
| ubsan | `crypto_box_fuzzer.ubsan` | 130,264 | `547ec7c11a1641bc5fc100b8c6479f4bd4f959567d6dd88bc82913c16de7f83a` |
| asan | `crypto_box_fuzzer.asan` | 887,448 | `f856155b2b8406fff173537cc325c3f75f2909c7cfdef790be7dade5c6d08f42` |
| asan-ubsan | `crypto_box_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 888,664 | `deeb924913efad45332d6f662c66de242121ccd4a42f48db7242a10abd184273` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
